name: Hendric
source:
Tall, sociable and fashionable - he has it all. Well, everything but a phone that is. It's not hard to see why people might find it easy to talk to him, or easy to not talk to him. 

"Let's go, I have the perfect idea."

[From [url=https://mellodrawmatic.itch.io/diffraction]itch.io[/url]]
